parameters.query: SELECT check_rate_limit({{ $json.client_id }}, '{{ $json.service_name }}', {{ $json.max_per_hour }}, 3600) as allowed_hourly, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(request_count), 0) FROM rate_limits WHERE client_id = {{ $json.client_id }} AND service_name = '{{ $json.service_name }}' AND window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as daily_usage

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ allowed: false, reason: 'Rate limit exceeded', service: $json.service_name, retry_after_seconds: $json.retry_after_seconds, daily_usage: $json.daily_usage, daily_limit: $json.daily_limit }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ allowed: true, service: $json.service_name, remaining_daily: $json.remaining_daily, daily_usage: $json.daily_usage, daily_limit: $json.daily_limit }) }}
